{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjccM8AAAABZkHg6Q", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IfzhDKwZU", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3If", "number": 77, "title": "Correct V30MZ direct near and far CALL timing and destination alignment", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `9e0da4a88f7c0b160349041a65f49f4a116a0faf`, `crates/ws-core/src/cpu.rs` leaves direct near CALL (`E8`) at the default execution charge and assigns six clocks to direct far CALL (`9A`). Both omit the odd-destination adjustment. Subroutine-heavy workloads therefore advance raster, timers and audio too little. Commercial-title impact remains unmeasured.

Existing `cpu/jmp_tests.rs` and `cpu/word_transfer_tests.rs` explicitly preserve obsolete near-CALL totals.

## Expected outcome

Correct both direct CALL encodings within the existing serialized accounting, retaining actual fetches, stack transfers and waits exactly once. Preserve return frames, architectural behavior and shared-device integration. Include necessary cross-file tests, fixture consumers and timing-documentation updates.

Indirect CALL/JMP, return-instruction timing, full prefetch, effective-address hazards and unrelated bus policies remain separate work.

## Context

The clean checkout matches inspected remote `main`. The open collection contains no Issues or PRs; all 76 closed entry titles were checked. [Issue #75](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/issues/75) and [PR #76](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/pull/76) explicitly leave CALL timing separate.

The [NEC V30MZ manual](https://www.renesas.com/en/document/lbr/v30mztm-hardware-preliminary), Appendix A, printed pp. 73 and 76, gives decoded near/far CALL totals of **5/10 clocks**, under aligned, no-wait/no-hold conditions, and adds one clock for an odd destination. Chapter 4 specifies additional transfers for unaligned words. The decoded totals include normal operand transfers: subtracting one/two aligned stack writes gives inferred residual execution components **4/8** in this repository. Thus use **actual fetch clocks + actual stack-write clocks + 4/8 + destination parity**, without destination pre-reading.

For unprefixed internal-RAM instructions and an accessible aligned internal stack, independently inferred totals are:

| Encoding | Even opcode, even/odd target | Odd opcode, even/odd target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E8 | 8 / 9 | 7 / 8 |
| 9A | 15 / 16 | 13 / 14 |

An odd internal stack adds one clock for E8 and two for 9A. These are serialized emulator expectations, not console measurements.

Correction record: the old AI-authored preservation assumption accepted five clocks for `E8 02 00` at `0000:1000`, targeting `1005` with an aligned internal stack. Replace it with **nine clocks**. Likewise replace far CALL’s six-clock residual with eight plus destination parity. The primary manual and existing transfer accounting establish the correction; preserve architectural and regression acceptance. Further evidence-based corrections must record the old assumption, replacement, source and rationale without a human-approval or independent AI re-review gate.

The inspected [WSTimingTest report](https://github.com/FluBBaOfWard/WSTimingTest/blob/025e606fc3b6615160ffdae485d992ffcad0c024/README.md) describes alignment effects but warns that aggregate loops include pipeline/harness effects. Its opcode-pattern workaround is unsuitable.

[Saved #75 validation](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/9e0da4a88f7c0b160349041a65f49f4a116a0faf/docs/issue-75-validation.md) reports 255 workspace tests, complete production Chromium suites and criterion-level review passing. Existing tests were inspected; this planning investigation executed no application builds or tests.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Record independent literal timing/state vectors before changing charges. Correct E8 and 9A using the accounting above; retain fetch consolidation, mapping and waits. Replace obsolete CALL assertions and documentation while preserving unrelated assertions. Expected values must not call production timing helpers.
- [ ] Cover both opcode/target/stack parities; near zero, forward, backward and signed-extreme displacements; immediate-fetch/IP wrapping; 20-bit addressing; and wrapping stack writes. Assert exact CS/IP/SP and return bytes/order: near saves the post-immediate IP; far saves original CS then post-immediate IP. Preserve full FLAGS, other registers/segments and unrelated memory. Exercise actual RET/RETF continuation without changing their timing policy.
- [ ] Cover accessible internal RAM and mapped ROM fetches, bank crossings and live A0 `00/04/08/0C`. Exercise stack transfers through existing mapped-memory/wait paths. Retain segment/BUSLOCK behavior through seven prefixes, SS-based stack addressing and existing REP rejection. Demonstrate destination memory is not read during CALL.
- [ ] Exercise emulated Mono/Color/SwanCrystal model configurations: Mono `00`; Color and SwanCrystal `00/80/C0/E0`, including live transitions back to `00`. Through normal `Machine::run_frame`, assert exact frame/raster, timer and audio advancement for representative near/far calls and prevent an extra destination instruction. Preserve IRQ/TF priority, shadows, saved continuations/IRET, REP/HALT, and separate GDMA/SDMA reservations and capability gates.
- [ ] Add a source-included original CC0 cartridge through existing fixture tooling, with independent native and production Chromium consumers. Require absolute budgets for near/far calls to even/odd destinations, CPU-written call/destination counts, stack/return integrity and continuation markers across supported configurations and fresh restart. Invalidate stale saved completion. Document every measured instruction, harness cost and timer quantization, including retained approximate return costs if used. Record actual old-code failures in both consumers and corrected passes; relative differences alone are insufficient.
- [ ] Independently recalculate any affected existing timing consumers. Preserve IRQ entry at 32/35 internal clocks and its former-charge rejection, plus existing IRQ/JMP/LOOP/Jcc architectural and absolute-budget acceptance. Retain unchanged interval budgets where measured bytes are unaffected. Document justified layout/oracle corrections without widening tolerances or rewriting historical observations.
- [ ] Preserve three-model startup/model behavior, firmware policy, LCD/input/frame continuity, audio/PCM, DMA/Hyper Voice, SRAM/cartridge/internal EEPROM and RTC retention, browser save integrity, local data handling and ownership/provenance. Coordinator runs `python3 fixtures/build.py --check`, `python3 demo/build.py --check`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo test --workspace --locked`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, and `git diff --check`. In `web`, run `npm run build:wasm`, `npm run build`, then complete `npm run test:browser` and `npm run test:compat` sequentially with `WS_PREVIEW_URL` targeting an explicit local production preview.
- [ ] Update timing documentation, fixture provenance and validation evidence with tested source/artifact identities, independent calculations, actual observations, failures, corrections and unperformed checks. Coordinator reviews the final diff and evidence against every criterion and resolves blocking findings before merge. All mandatory checks use automated native/browser tooling.

## Optional validation

Additional lawful software experiments, another browser engine, console measurements and human gameplay may supplement automated evidence. These were unperformed during planning and are not merge prerequisites. Commercial-game compatibility and complete console pipeline timing remain unestablished.

## Required post-merge verification

None.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WonderSwan-family hardware goal.
Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance criteria when primary hardware
specifications establish the correction. Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.

This autonomous campaign has no human-approval gate. Mandatory acceptance uses
automated native and production-browser tests on the emulator's supported model
and mode configurations. Physical-console measurements and human gameplay are
optional evidence and must remain explicitly unperformed unless actually available.
Do not invent device identities, real-device results or a requirement for human
confirmation. Resolve technical errors with recorded evidence and automated checks
through the existing Coordinator workflow.
